cues.text: A blue butterfly in the dark.
Words appear. Time waits for no one. All are equal in its flow, all lives borne to their ends.
You, who would protect the glimmer of the finite future.
You have a single year. Go forth, and live in the time given to you.
Even in these halcyon days of repose, let your heart guide you, and never stray from its path.
